fichas.title: Children’s ward with 28 beds
fichas.summary: Plan example for a children’s ward at Velbert City Hospital. The accompanying text recommends child-friendly design resembling a kindergarten, with provision for teaching, activities, play, and isolation where needed.

fichas.title: Patient rooms for radiology care
fichas.summary: Plan examples show single- and two-bed rooms with strong radiation protection in a radiology ward’s controlled area, and a four-bed room equipped for basic care. The text says radiotherapy patients should be accommodated in single-bed rooms, with controlled and supervised areas separated in accordance with radiation protection requirements.

fichas.title: Psychiatric care at Finsterwalde Hospital
fichas.summary: Hospital plan example for psychiatric care, captioned as a 70-bed hospital. The drawings identify group-care arrangements labelled 17-bed and 18-bed, patient bedrooms, workrooms, day rooms, dining rooms, therapy spaces, and shared facilities. The accompanying text describes small care units of up to 18 patients and emphasizes short circulation routes and a homely environment.
